name: adhd-social-media-engine
description: ADHD Social Media Engine: a proof-first content system for one-person social accounts run by ADHD brains. brain-mode routes today's work to the brain that showed up (Feral, Froggy, Foggy, Fried); a Bank of finished posts covers the low days; every claim cites a receipt from your Proof Locker; every number is computed by script, not guessed. 11 skills covering positioning, audience research, hooks, scripts, repurposing, a capacity-checked 30-day calendar, analytics review, and post autopsies.
